blocks.text: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: ta'rif otdan keyin keladi

Relative clause (aniqlovchi ergash gap) otga ta'rif beradi: **qaysi** odam, **qaysi** narsa? Asosini qizil kitobdan bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 101–102-darslar). Bu darsning asosiy masalasi — **so'z tartibi**, chunki o'zbek va ingliz tillari bu yerda butunlay teskari ishlaydi. O'zbekchada ta'rif, qanchalik uzun bo'lmasin, otdan **oldin** turadi: «**kecha bizga yordam bergan** qo'shnimiz». Inglizchada esa ot **birinchi** keladi, ta'rif esa undan **keyin**, **who / that / which** bilan boshlanadi va oddiy gapdek davom etadi: our neighbour **who helped us yesterday**. Bu darsda **who / that / which** ta'rif ichida **ega** vazifasida: harakatni o'sha odam yoki narsaning o'zi bajaradi.

rows: the bus **that goes** to the airport
the students **who didn't pass** the exam

blocks.text: Tarjima usuli: otni oldinga olib chiqing

O'zbekcha birikmani inglizchaga o'girishda uch qadam bor: 1) birikmaning **oxiridagi otni** toping («...yordam bergan **qo'shnimiz**») va uni birinchi qo'ying: **our neighbour**; 2) odam bo'lsa **who**, narsa bo'lsa **that / which** qo'shing; 3) sifatdoshni (`-gan`, `-adigan`, `-yotgan`) **oddiy fe'lga** aylantiring va qolgan qismni odatdagi inglizcha tartibda yozing: who **helped** us yesterday. O'zbek sifatdoshida zamon noaniq bo'lishi mumkin, inglizchada esa **zamonni aniq tanlash** shart.

items.text: The neighbour **who helped** us yesterday is a doctor.
items.translation: Kecha bizga **yordam bergan** qo'shnimiz shifokor ekan.

items.text: The children **who are playing** outside are my nephews.

blocks.text: who, that, which — qachon qaysi biri

**Odamlar** uchun — **who** (eng ko'p) yoki **that** (so'zlashuvda). **Narsa, hayvon, tashkilot** uchun — **that** (so'zlashuvda ko'proq) yoki **which** (yozma, rasmiyroq matnda ko'p). Odam uchun **which** — xato («the man which»), narsa uchun **who** — xato. Uy hayvoni haqida mehr bilan gapirganda who ham eshitiladi (our dog, **who** ...), lekin bu shart emas. **something, everything, nothing, all, the only, the first** va orttirma darajadan keyin **that** afzal (→ 93-dars). **what** esa aniqlovchi ergash gapni boshlamaydi: «the book what ...» — xato (what ning to'g'ri ishlatilishi → 93-dars).

items.text: I need a lawyer **who** understands tax law.
She works for a charity **which** helps refugees.
items.translation: U qochqinlarga **yordam beradigan** xayriya tashkilotida ishlaydi.

items.text: This is the best thing **that** has happened to me this year.
items.translation: Bu shu yil men bilan **bo'lgan** eng yaxshi voqea.

blocks.text: **who / that / which** ning o'z soni yo'q — undan keyingi fe'l **o'zidan oldingi otga** moslashadi: a man who **lives** (birlik), people who **live** (ko'plik). Qiyin holat: **one of the people who** ... — bu yerda ta'rif **people** ga tegishli, shuning uchun fe'l ko'plikda: She's one of the few people who **understand** this. Lekin **the only one who** — birlik: He's the only one who **knows** the password.

Ta'rif asosiy gapning **egasiga** tegishli bo'lsa, u ega bilan asosiy fe'l orasiga tushadi: The woman **who lives next door** | **is** a nurse. Uzun ta'rifdan keyin asosiy fe'lni yo'qotib qo'ymaslik uchun ta'rifni xayolan qavsga oling: The woman (who lives next door) **is** a nurse. O'zbekchada esa asosiy fe'l odatdagidek oxirda: «Qo'shni uyda yashaydigan ayol — hamshira». Muhim: asosiy fe'ldan oldin egani **olmosh bilan takrorlamang** — «The woman who lives next door **she** is a nurse» — xato.

items.text: The man **who lives** above us **plays** the drums at night.
Players **who arrive** late **don't play** in the next match.
She's one of the few people **who understand** this software.
items.translation: U bu dasturni **tushunadigan** sanoqli odamlardan biri.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have a friend who **she** lives in Oxford» → who lives (who ning o'zi ega); «The man who sold me the car **he** disappeared» → The man who sold me the car disappeared; «the man **which** ...» → the man **who**; «people who **lives**» → people who **live**; o'zbekcha tartibni ko'chirish: «the yesterday arrived guests» → the guests **who arrived** yesterday; «the book **what** won the prize» → the book **that** won the prize.

Ikki gapga bo'lib tekshiring: «I have a friend. **She** lives in Oxford.» → ikkinchi gapdagi **she** o'rniga **who** qo'ying va gaplarni birlashtiring: I have a friend **who** lives in Oxford. **she** yo'qoladi — uning o'rnini who egalladi.

Keyingi darslar: who / that **to'ldiruvchi** bo'lganda tushib qolishi va predlog oxirida (→ 93-dars); whose, whom, where (→ 94-dars); vergulli, qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gaplar (→ 95–96-darslar); the woman **talking** to Tom kabi qisqargan shakllar (→ 97-dars).

rows: The man who called me **is** my boss.

examples.title: **who** for people: the woman **who** ...
examples.description: Odam haqida — who (so'zlashuvda that ham). who ta'rif ichida ega: harakatni o'sha odamning o'zi bajaradi.

sentences.text: I've got a cousin **who works** as a pilot for an airline in Dubai.
sentences.translation: Dubaydagi aviakompaniyada uchuvchi bo'lib **ishlaydigan** amakivachcham bor.

sentences.text: The woman **who answered** the phone was very helpful.
sentences.translation: Telefonni **ko'targan** ayol juda yordam berdi.

sentences.text: We need someone **who speaks** both Russian and English.
sentences.translation: Bizga ham rus, ham ingliz tilida **gapiradigan** odam kerak.

sentences.text: Do you know the man **who is standing** next to Madina?
sentences.translation: Madinaning yonida **turgan** erkakni taniysizmi?

sentences.text: People **who cycle** to work every day rarely complain about traffic jams.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ishga velosipedda **qatnaydigan** odamlar tirbandlikdan kamdan-kam shikoyat qiladi.

sentences.text: Oliver is the kind of person **who never forgets** a birthday.
sentences.translation: Oliver hech qachon tug'ilgan kunni **unutmaydigan** odamlardan.

sentences.text: The tourists **who missed** the bus had to take a taxi to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Avtobusdan **qolib ketgan** sayyohlar Xivaga taksida borishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Thank you to everyone **who helped** us after the flood.
sentences.translation: Seldan keyin bizga **yordam bergan** har bir kishiga rahmat.

sentences.text: A friend of mine **who lives** in Edinburgh says the summers there are cool.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **yashaydigan** bir do'stimning aytishicha, u yerda yoz salqin bo'larkan.

sentences.text: The doctor **who operated** on my father has thirty years of experience.
sentences.translation: Otamni **operatsiya qilgan** shifokorning o'ttiz yillik tajribasi bor.

examples.title: **that** / **which** for things and animals
examples.description: Narsa, hayvon, tashkilot haqida — that (so'zlashuvda ko'proq) yoki which (rasmiyroq). Odam uchun which ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: Is there a bus **that goes** directly to the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri **boradigan** avtobus bormi?

sentences.text: I bought a phone **which takes** amazing photos at night.
sentences.translation: Kechasi ajoyib suratga **oladigan** telefon sotib oldim.

sentences.text: The bridge **that collapsed** last year has finally been rebuilt.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili **qulagan** ko'prik nihoyat qayta qurildi.

sentences.text: We stayed in a hotel **that had** a pool on the roof.
sentences.translation: Tomida basseyni **bo'lgan** mehmonxonada qoldik.

sentences.text: Companies **which pollute** rivers should pay heavy fines.
sentences.translation: Daryolarni **ifloslantiradigan** kompaniyalar katta jarima to'lashi kerak.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has a cat **that sleeps** on her laptop all day.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning kun bo'yi noutbuki ustida **uxlaydigan** mushugi bor.

sentences.text: This is the app **that tells** you when your bus is coming.
sentences.translation: Bu — avtobusingiz qachon kelishini **aytib turadigan** ilova.

sentences.text: The law **which comes** into force next month will ban plastic bags.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy kuchga **kiradigan** qonun plastik paketlarni taqiqlaydi.

sentences.text: This little shop has a smell **that reminds** me of my grandmother's kitchen.
sentences.translation: Bu kichkina do'konda menga buvimning oshxonasini **eslatadigan** hid bor.

sentences.text: Kate ordered a dish **that contained** nuts, and she had an allergic reaction.
sentences.translation: Keyt tarkibida yong'oq **bo'lgan** taom buyurtma qildi va unda allergiya boshlandi.

examples.title: Uzbek order → English order: long descriptions
examples.description: O'zbekchada uzun ta'rif otdan oldin turadi («kecha divanni ko'tarishga yordam bergan qo'shnimiz»), inglizchada — otdan keyin, who / that bilan.

sentences.text: The neighbour **who helped** us carry the sofa yesterday is a professional boxer.
sentences.translation: Kecha divanni ko'tarishimizga **yordam bergan** qo'shnimiz professional bokschi ekan.

sentences.text: I met a girl **who grew up** in the same village in Fergana as my mother.
sentences.translation: Onam bilan Farg'onaning bitta qishlog'ida **o'sgan** bir qizni uchratdim.

sentences.text: Students **who don't hand in** their essays by Friday will lose marks.
sentences.translation: Inshosini jumagacha **topshirmagan** talabalar ball yo'qotadi.

sentences.text: There's a café near the station **that serves** the best samsa in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida Toshkentdagi eng mazali somsani **pishiradigan** kafe bor.

sentences.text: The scientist **who discovered** the new virus has won an international prize.
sentences.translation: Yangi virusni **kashf qilgan** olim xalqaro mukofotga sazovor bo'ldi.

sentences.text: We're looking for a flat **that is** close to a metro station and not too expensive.
sentences.translation: Metro bekatiga yaqin va unchalik qimmat **bo'lmagan** kvartira qidiryapmiz.

sentences.text: Aziz works for a company **that makes** solar panels for schools in rural areas.
sentences.translation: Aziz qishloq joylardagi maktablar uchun quyosh panellari **ishlab chiqaradigan** kompaniyada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Anyone **who wants** to join the trip to Samarkand must sign up by Monday.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga sayohatga qo'shilishni **xohlagan** har kim dushanbagacha ro'yxatdan o'tishi kerak.

sentences.text: The young man **who was sitting** behind us on the plane snored the whole flight.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda orqamizda **o'tirgan** yigit butun parvoz davomida xurrak otdi.

sentences.text: I'll never forget the teacher **who encouraged** me to study abroad when nobody else believed in me.
sentences.translation: Hech kim menga ishonmagan paytda chet elda o'qishga **undagan** o'qituvchini hech qachon unutmayman.

examples.title: Any tense inside: who **has seen**, that **will connect**
examples.description: Ta'rif ichida istalgan zamon bo'lishi mumkin. O'zbekcha «-gan», «-adigan», «-yotgan» o'rniga inglizchada zamon aniq tanlanadi.

sentences.text: The shop **that opened** last week is already full every evening.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta **ochilgan** do'kon allaqachon har kechqurun gavjum.

sentences.text: Anyone **who has seen** the missing child should call the police.
sentences.translation: Yo'qolgan bolani **ko'rgan** har bir kishi politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishi kerak.

sentences.text: The new line **that will connect** the airport to the city centre opens in 2027.
sentences.translation: Aeroportni shahar markazi bilan **bog'laydigan** yangi liniya 2027-yilda ochiladi.

sentences.text: I spoke to a man **who had worked** in the factory for forty years.
sentences.translation: Fabrikada qirq yil **ishlagan** bir kishi bilan gaplashdim.

sentences.text: Look, there's the girl **who's waving** at us from the other side of the street — do you know her?
sentences.translation: Qara, ko'chaning narigi tomonidan bizga qo'l **silkitayotgan** qiz — uni taniysanmi?

sentences.text: Patients **who are waiting** for an operation will get a letter from the hospital.
sentences.translation: Operatsiya **kutayotgan** bemorlarga shifoxonadan xat keladi.

sentences.text: Nilufar is the only person in our group **who has never been** late.
sentences.translation: Nilufar guruhimizda hech qachon **kechikmagan** yagona odam.

sentences.text: The team **that wins** tonight will play in the final in London.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **yutgan** jamoa Londondagi finalda o'ynaydi.

sentences.text: People **who can't** drive can use the free shuttle bus.
sentences.translation: Mashina **hayday olmaydigan** odamlar bepul avtobusdan foydalanishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Because of the heat, the engineers **who were repairing** the road had to stop work.
sentences.translation: Jazirama tufayli yo'lni **ta'mirlayotgan** muhandislar ishni to'xtatishga majbur bo'lishdi.

examples.title: In the middle: The woman **who** ... **is** ...
examples.description: Ta'rif gapning egasiga tegishli bo'lsa, u ega bilan asosiy fe'l orasiga tushadi. Asosiy fe'ldan oldin ega olmosh bilan takrorlanmaydi.

sentences.text: The mechanic **who fixed** my car last month **has opened** his own garage.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy mashinamni **tuzatgan** usta o'z ustaxonasini **ochibdi**.

sentences.text: Flats **that overlook** the park **are** the most expensive in the building.
sentences.translation: Bog'ga **qaragan** kvartiralar binodagi eng qimmat kvartiralar **hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: People **who drive** while texting **cause** thousands of accidents every year.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydayotib xabar **yozadigan** odamlar har yili minglab avariyalarga **sabab bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the email **that arrived** this morning **contained** a virus.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bugun ertalab **kelgan** xatda virus **bor ekan**.

sentences.text: The girl **who won** the poetry competition **is** only twelve years old.
sentences.translation: She'riyat tanlovida **g'olib bo'lgan** qiz atigi o'n ikki **yoshda**.

sentences.text: Yesterday a man **who claimed** to be from the bank **phoned** my grandmother.
sentences.translation: Kecha bankdan ekanini **da'vo qilgan** bir kishi buvimga **qo'ng'iroq qildi**.

sentences.text: In my experience, the train **that leaves** at 7.15 **is** less crowded.
sentences.translation: Tajribamdan bilaman, soat 7:15 da **jo'naydigan** poyezd kamroq gavjum **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Everybody **who attended** the workshop **received** a certificate.
sentences.translation: Seminarda **qatnashgan** hamma sertifikat **oldi**.

sentences.text: Sarah's colleague **who sits** next to her **talks** on the phone all day.
sentences.translation: Saraning yonida **o'tiradigan** hamkasbi kun bo'yi telefonda **gaplashadi**.

sentences.text: The road **which links** our village to the town **was** closed for a week after the landslide.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizni shahar bilan **bog'laydigan** yo'l ko'chkidan keyin bir hafta **yopiq turdi**.

examples.title: Definitions: someone **who** ..., something **that** ...
examples.description: So'z ma'nosini tushuntirish uchun eng qulay qolip: A ... is someone who ... / something that ... Lug'atlar ham shunday yozadi.

sentences.text: A surgeon is a doctor **who performs** operations.
sentences.translation: Jarroh — operatsiya **qiladigan** shifokor.

sentences.text: A volunteer is someone **who works** without being paid.
sentences.translation: Ko'ngilli — haq olmasdan **ishlaydigan** odam.

sentences.text: A charger is a device **that puts** power back into a battery.
sentences.translation: Quvvatlagich — batareyani **zaryadlaydigan** qurilma.

sentences.text: What do you call a person **who designs** buildings? — An architect.
sentences.translation: Binolarni **loyihalaydigan** odamni nima deyishadi? — Arxitektor.

sentences.text: An optimist is a person **who expects** good things to happen.
sentences.translation: Optimist — hamisha yaxshilik **kutadigan** odam.

sentences.text: Is there a word for a thing **that stops** a door from closing?
sentences.translation: Eshikning yopilib qolishiga **yo'l qo'ymaydigan** narsa uchun so'z bormi?

sentences.text: Translators are people **who turn** texts from one language into another.
sentences.translation: Tarjimonlar — matnlarni bir tildan boshqasiga **o'giradigan** odamlar.

sentences.text: Thermometers are instruments **which measure** temperature.
sentences.translation: Termometrlar — haroratni **o'lchaydigan** asboblar.

sentences.text: Freelancers are workers **who don't have** a permanent employer.
sentences.translation: Frilanserlar — doimiy ish beruvchisi **bo'lmagan** ishchilar.

sentences.text: In football, the referee is the person **who decides** whether a goal counts.
sentences.translation: Futbolda hakam — gol hisoblanish-hisoblanmasligini **hal qiladigan** odam.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: anyone **who** ...?
examples.description: Ta'rif savol va inkor gaplarda ham keladi: Do you know anyone who ...? There's nobody who ... I don't like films that ...

sentences.text: Do you know anyone **who can fix** an old laptop?
sentences.translation: Eski noutbukni **tuzata oladigan** biror kishini bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Is there a pharmacy near here **that's open** all night?
sentences.translation: Bu yaqin atrofda tun bo'yi **ochiq turadigan** dorixona bormi?

sentences.text: I don't like films **that have** sad endings.
sentences.translation: Oxiri qayg'uli **bo'lgan** filmlarni yoqtirmayman.

sentences.text: There's nobody in my family **who enjoys** football as much as I do.
sentences.translation: Oilamda futbolni men kabi yaxshi **ko'radigan** hech kim yo'q.

sentences.text: Have you ever met someone **who has climbed** Everest?
sentences.translation: Everestga **chiqqan** biror kishini hech uchratganmisiz?

sentences.text: Why do you always choose restaurants **that are** so expensive?
sentences.translation: Nega doim bunchalik qimmat **bo'lgan** restoranlarni tanlaysan?

sentences.text: We don't employ people **who aren't** willing to learn.
sentences.translation: Biz o'rganishga tayyor **bo'lmagan** odamlarni ishga olmaymiz.

sentences.text: Which is the bus **that stops** outside the university?
sentences.translation: Universitet oldida **to'xtaydigan** avtobus qaysi biri?

sentences.text: Is it true that you have a parrot **which speaks** three languages?
sentences.translation: Uch tilda **gapiradigan** to'tiqushingiz borligi rostmi?

sentences.text: There isn't a single shop in the village **that sells** fresh bread on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda yakshanba kunlari yangi non **sotadigan** birorta ham do'kon yo'q.

examples.title: Mixed: relative clauses in the news and at work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: who / that / which ega vazifasida — yangiliklar, ish va kundalik hayot gaplarida. one of those people who + ko'plik fe'l.

sentences.text: The government has announced a scheme **that will help** young families buy their first home.
sentences.translation: Hukumat yosh oilalarga birinchi uyini sotib olishga **yordam beradigan** dasturni e'lon qildi.

sentences.text: Madina is the only one in our team **who understands** the new software.
sentences.translation: Madina jamoamizda yangi dasturni **tushunadigan** yagona odam.

sentences.text: Scientists have developed a test **that can detect** the disease in minutes.
sentences.translation: Olimlar kasallikni bir necha daqiqada **aniqlay oladigan** test ishlab chiqishdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is one of those people **who never stop** talking about their jobs.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishi haqida gapirishdan hech **to'xtamaydigan** odamlardan biri.

sentences.text: Passengers **who are travelling** to London should go to platform four.
sentences.translation: Londonga **ketayotgan** yo'lovchilar to'rtinchi platformaga o'tishlari kerak.

sentences.text: My sister bought a dress **that cost** more than my monthly salary!
sentences.translation: Opam mening oylik maoshimdan ham qimmat **turgan** ko'ylak sotib oldi!

sentences.text: The village **that was destroyed** in the earthquake has been completely rebuilt.
sentences.translation: Zilzilada **vayron bo'lgan** qishloq butunlay qayta qurildi.

sentences.text: James wants to work for a company **which cares** about the environment.
sentences.translation: Jeyms atrof-muhitga **g'amxo'rlik qiladigan** kompaniyada ishlamoqchi.

sentences.text: Any player **who gets** two yellow cards has to leave the pitch.
sentences.translation: Ikkita sariq kartochka **olgan** har qanday o'yinchi maydonni tark etishi kerak.

sentences.text: It was Jasur's grandmother **who taught** him to cook plov, not his mother.
sentences.translation: Jasurga palov damlashni onasi emas, buvisi **o'rgatgan**.
